name: AI hyperreal image
summary: A recognisable look of images made by generative models: smooth, evenly lit, over-detailed and glossy. The look is named here so that a brief can ask for it or, more often, avoid it.

philosophy.core_thesis: A generated image can pass for a photograph at a glance, and its tells are the numbers that no real camera and no real scene would give together.
design_principles: Name the tells: skin with no pores at 100%, hair as a smooth mass, and eyes with a perfect catchlight.
Name the light: a soft wrap with a key-to-fill ratio of 1.5:1 or less, and no clear light source.
Name the lens: a claimed 85mm f/1.4 look at all distances, with a blur that has no stepped depth.
Name the grade: glossy, saturated, a teal-orange split and no grain.
Name the failures: hands with extra or merged fingers, text that reads as nonsense and reflections that do not match.
Use the look on purpose, in a label, or avoid it in a brief by adding the real numbers of a style.
anti_patterns: Passing a generated image as a documentary photograph
Skin smoothing past the point of pores
Impossible lens blur that ignores distance
Text in the image that is not checked
Using the look for a scene that must be true, such as news or evidence
Copying the face or the style of a living artist by name

composition.framing: Centred and complete; the subject is clear and placed to read at thumbnail size.
composition.viewpoint: Eye height or slightly low, at a claimed 1m to 3m.
composition.geometry: Smooth curves and symmetric forms; the background has dense, repeated detail.
composition.subject_placement: Centred or on a third by rule, with a busy, glowing background.

principles.rule: Let 1 subject take 40–70% of the frame, lit to the highest contrast in the image.
Place the face axis at 0.5 of the width, within 0.05.
Set 50% in one dominant hue, 30% in its complement and 20% in neutrals, with a glow at the edge.
Use 2 planes only: a sharp subject and a blurred background that has no stepped depth.
Hold the scene range at 4 to 5 stops, with no crushed blacks and no clipped highlights.

light.quality: Soft, wrapped and shadowless; a glow without a source.
light.direction: Frontal wrap with a rim at 135°; no clear cast shadow.
light.time_of_day: Not set; a permanent golden hour

lens_and_camera.format: None: the look imitates full frame
lens_and_camera.focus: The eyes are sharp; the blur grows evenly, with no true depth steps.

colour_and_grade.treatment: Glossy, saturated and clean with a teal-orange split and no grain.
grade_recipe: Set the saturation at +25% and the vibrance at +20%.
Split-tone shadows to teal (hue 190, saturation 20%) and highlights to orange (hue 30, saturation 25%).
Lift the black point to 3% and the white point to 99%.
Apply a +25% clarity and +15% texture on the whole frame.
To avoid the look: drop saturation by −20%, add grain at 25% and add a hard shadow.
colour_and_grade.grain: None; to avoid the look, add Tri-X grain at 25%

subject_and_staging.staging: None in the real world. The scene is prompted: subject, mood, lens and light in 8 to 12 phrases.
subject_and_staging.direction: Check every hand, every text and every reflection before use; label the image as generated.

workflow: Check hands, text, reflections and symmetry.
Upscale to 2048px or more and correct the colour.
Label the file as AI-generated in its metadata.
post_processing.output: A glossy file at 1:1, 4:5 or 16:9, with a label that says it was generated.

canonical_works.work: The Pope in a white puffer jacket

emotion.target_response: First, wonder at the polish; then, on a second look, unease at a surface with no source.

use_cases: naming the look in a brief so that a team can avoid it
teaching how to spot generated images
a negative prompt block for real photo styles
avoid_when: The image must be true: news, evidence, documentary or a product as sold.
The brief asks to pass the image as a real photograph.

modifiers.how: Say 35mm lens, available light, f/5.6, grain at 15% and a real place with clutter; remove the glow and the polish.
Say shot on Portra 400, halation at 20%, lifted blacks at 5% and visible grain at 35%; cut the saturation by 20%.

grain.note: The look has no grain; a high ISO breaks the gloss.
